testcase.name: every url-carrying tool family member is gated on the domain dimension
artifact write targets are gated including their schema defaults
narrowed system dimension also covers the device permission tools
missing or blank required path is denied fail-closed while optional path defaults to the root
url without a parseable host is denied fail-closed
nested root allows only paths contained under it
file_move checks both source and target
download_file write target is gated while its url stays under the domain dimension
permissive policy passes every family
denial output is the structured policy_denied payload with the permission trace
traversal with dot-dot escapes is denied
absent optional path arguments check their schema defaults or touch nothing
subdomain matches the parent domain but a lookalike does not
capability not in the allowlist is denied while allowed ones and unmapped tools pass
unmodeled root domains are denied while the path dimension is active
family tools with workspace path arguments are gated
absolute non-workspace path is allowed under a matching external root
optional url tools skip absent and non-web arguments but gate http urls
null dimensions each stay unrestricted
allowShell false denies terminal tools and never executes the body
workspace path under an allowed root executes
